verdict.rationale: Zoho Invoice documents several of its own background automations: automated payment reminders, invoices scheduled to send on a chosen date, recurring invoices at regular intervals, automatic quote-to-invoice conversion, and automatic card charging for recurring transactions. These are fixed, invoicing-specific automations rather than a general automation builder, so the 'set up automations' part of the story is only partly met. Missing for 10: a user-configurable workflow or automation-rule builder (custom triggers and actions), any AI or agent-driven autonomous behavior, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: automate payment reminders with Zoho Invoice
Zoho Invoice lets you schedule your invoices to be automatically sent to your customers on the date you choose.
Create recurring invoices for transactions that occur at regular intervals, so you don't have to create them individually every time.
When your customer accepts a quote, automatically convert it to an invoice and send it out for payment.
Store your customers' card information to automatically charge them for recurring transactions.
